title: Ladakh CS Urges High Turnout Amid Poll Deferment Demand

ai.summary: Ladakh Chief Secretary Ashish Kundra urged high voter turnout for December 4 LAHDC elections amid ongoing sit-in and hunger strike by Leh Apex Body demanding election deferment due to population migration.

facts.claim: Ladakh Chief Secretary Ashish Kundra urged high voter turnout for December 4 LAHDC elections
facts.quote: Ladakh Chief Secretary Ashish Kundra on Sunday appealed to voters across all eight districts to participate in the polls in large numbers and exercise their franchise.

facts.claim: Ongoing sit-in and hunger strike by Leh Apex Body demanding election deferment
facts.quote: Amid the Leh Apex Body’s (LAB) ongoing sit-in and hunger strike in Leh, seeking dialogue with the Centre and deferment of the December 4 LAHDC elections

facts.claim: Population migration due to harsh winter conditions
facts.quote: citing the migration of 30 to 50 per cent of the population outside Ladakh due to harsh winter conditions

ai.background_note: Ladakh, a union territory without a legislature since 2019, has been seeking statehood through protests against the Centre's election process for the Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Councils.
